Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Documented keratoconus  [OR] or ectasia after refractive surgery
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Insufficient corneal thickness
  -  Ocular condition that may predispose the eye to complications
  -  History of chemical injury  [OR] or delayed epithelial healing
  -  Condition that would interfere  [OR] with or prolong epithelial healing
  -  Known sensitivity to treatment medications
  -  Pregnancy
